hypothesis: Receiver-conditioned modulation of the dense64D label message may supply useful label-identity-dependent class direction beyond the fixed one-class route direction and outperform the capable matched joint/fully-untied references under the existing whole-task gate. No present utility claim.

gate.init: exact A=0,b=0 for every gate; no random reset/draw
gate.zero_context: zero dense message stays zero; retain explicit native-probability fallback

C4_gate.loss: mean of4own label CE via4CE/4 backwards at one old parameter state
C4_gate.Adam_scope: all BE/core/gate learned parameters in one fresh Adam

S_joint4head_gate.gate_sharing: one shared A,b over4untied dense messages before concat
S_joint4head_gate.readout: concat4x64 -> bias-free Linear256->256 -> ReLU -> bias-free Linear256->10
S_joint4head_gate.Adam_scope: all4heads, nonlinear joint readout and common gate in one fresh Adam

U4_sameB_full_untied_gate.gate_sharing: independent A_m,b_m inside each route; no learned sharing across routes
U4_sameB_full_untied_gate.loss: four own CE/4 backwards at old parameters, as P0
U4_sameB_full_untied_gate.Adam_scope: one fresh Adam per complete route, including its own gate

S_one_path_gate.Adam_scope: all one-path maps and gate in one fresh Adam

C4_gate_identity_erased.gate_sharing: one shared A,b over4BE routes, as C4_gate
C4_gate_identity_erased.loss: same4own CE/4 on original supervised TRAIN targets
C4_gate_identity_erased.Adam_scope: all original BE/core/gate learned parameters in one fresh Adam
C4_gate_identity_erased.value_identity: fixed uniform10-class code for every visible TRAIN anchor, all training and serving calls
C4_gate_identity_erased.effective_embedding_input_dimension: row mean64D;640nominal scalars; row contrasts unidentifiable through value inputs
does_not_erase: native TRAIN labels or native H

fixed_task.roles: Original split0 TRAIN; development val|stopping; no TEST truths

native: same3authentic original own-selected native states; frozen B; no new native training; same P0 one full eval capture per seed; unchanged frozen H11701x512 and native logits11701x10
mask: Uniform 290 of 580 per update; isolated CPU mask seed native_seed+1900001; same ordered positions, IDs and draw IDs for every bank
mask_exclusion: All Q labels zero in every label-derived field; rebuild per update

label_operator_fixed.neighbor_denominator: All observed incoming nonself records, including zero-value nodes; order and multiplicity preserved

supervision: zero base logits during label-stage training as P0: label CE only; true masked TRAIN targets retained in every arm

initialization_preserved.nonlinear_joint_readout: native_seed+700001; isolated CPU RNG; hidden Linear reset and zero final weight

optimization.shared_gate_graph_for_C4_routes: recompute gate forward per route for separate CE/4 backwards; do not cache/detach gamma or reuse a freed autograd graph

selection: After every label update, serve all 5274 development nodes for every entire bank. Each arm selects the strict first maximum complete correctcount across all 1100 updates. Store coherent entire arm parameters+Adam with native/cache/source custody. No native-local reset during the label stage.

serving.NLL_floor_bound: NLL_served <= NLL_native + log(5) in exact arithmetic; no accuracy/calibration guarantee
serving.family: Mean actual served route mixtures; joint single has one posterior and the same 4/5 label-family weight
serving.label_support: Structural permitted TRAIN-neighbor boolean; same across arms; no learned confidence gate
serving.per_route: No permitted TRAIN nonself neighbor: exact p_native; otherwise (1/5)*p_native+(4/5)*softmax(label_logits)
serving.scores: Stable log-softmax, log-add-exp and log-mean-exp; no clipping or recalibration grid

primary_quality_rule_inherited.member_semantics: Actual per-route bounded mixtures. Compute each seed min-member accuracy / max-member NLL contrast, then take its equal-weighted mean over three seeds. A single prediction defines both mean and worst metrics.
primary_quality_rule_inherited.opening: Only after all 3 seed blocks / all 15 bank endpoints complete 1100 updates; no partial comparative opening

label_identity_interpretation_qualificat.failure_interpretation: If erased values match or meet the candidate benefit without the required positive contrast, label-identity utility is not established; anchor-activated H classifier/support effects remain plausible.
label_identity_interpretation_qualificat.capacity_limit: Uniform-code erasure retains nominal matrices but removes class-conditioned value capacity and introduces a 576D embedding-row-contrast nullspace. A positive full-versus-erased contrast is evidence under this fixed intervention; it does not prove that every gain uses semantically correct neighbor labels.

secondary: fixed one-visible-class cohort diagnostics without subgroup selection or rescue
pre_result_failure_criterion: Any required complete-task co-primary contrast fails the inherited accuracy/NLL/member safeguards: the proposed family utility hypothesis fails on this task.
Any missing endpoint, changed mask/native state, incomplete optimizer ownership, nonzero no-context correction or improper identity erasure invalidates qualification.
Failure of the identity-erased contrast fails the label-identity interpretation, even if some full-arm improvement exists.
No coefficient/init/horizon/seed/epoch/subgroup rescue or post-result threshold change.
causal_limit: These five arms assess the gated family. They do not by themselves identify an isolated gate causal effect versus ungated P0. P0 is preserved as a separately running/scoped hypothesis.

ancestry.paper: GNN-FiLM: Graph Neural Networks with Feature-wise Linear Modulation
ancestry.source: saved limited conclusion, not new primary reread
ancestry.claim: established receiver-conditioned featurewise message modulation; multiplicative-only restriction here; FiLM/BE ingredients not claimed novel

implementation_readiness: Inactive helper and unapplied insertion diff only. No complete trainer fork, no installation into sealed P0, no numerical qualification or release.
native_supervision_interpretation: Native H encodes original TRAIN supervision. Literal Q masking in label fields does not create out-of-sample native predictions on TRAIN.
